tools.name: Moka
tools.why: Moka is a savings and investing app that rounds up everyday purchases and invests the spare change, with options for recurring contributions. It is offered for Canadian residents, so it may not be available to you in the UK.

tools.name: Motive Financial Savvy Savings Account
tools.why: This is an online savings account rather than an app, with no monthly fee and no minimum balance, and deposits are CDIC-insured. It is offered in Canada only, so it would not be available to a UK resident.
